avis.titre: As a setting mist and to go to bed with some mist moisture!! I love it
avis.texte: I am loving this spray mist. I use it after I put on my tinted sunscreen and at night, after my moisturizer. It is just amazing. I get compliments on my skin with the glass like moisture.. I will be a faithful user from now on. I pair this with numbuzin NAD+ number 9 and a couple number 5 series. I have been using for two weeks and I am noticing and so are my friends. These two companies have some wonderful products.

I LOVE this PDRN ampoule spray! It is super hydrating- I use it as a toner, and throughout the day as a refresh for makeup to improve the glow. I have sensitive, reactive skin and it feels very hydrating. The mist is extremely fine and it seems like it’ll last a long time. Doesn’t seem to have any scent, which I prefer. This will be one I always keep in supply.

This one so far is my favorite. Definitely will order again. Tried few other similar products but it’s always something wrong - too sticky, or greasy or drying out my skin. This one it lightweight, not sticky, not greasy, very soothing and hydrating

I love ANY skincare product I can spray on and let dry and this is no exception. It absorbs quickly, makes my skin feel soft, has no scent to it so I don’t get any headaches from an overwhelming odor, and it stays on for hours. I’ve seen some improvement in my skin in that it doesn’t seem to get as oily as quickly which I appreciate. I’m 51 yo and I still get acne and I have oily skin so I don’t like any product that could possibly add anything that can cause any additional oil on my skin.

This xl bottle of ampoule face mist is such a delight. Its not greasy doesnt tack or feel sticky. Leaves my face refreshed, moisturized && glowing for that glass skin finish.. doesnt irritate my skin especially if its irritated already. The mist is fine an even coating the face in just a few sprays, but if your like me you indulge in the spritz. Got mine during a sale making it a fantastic value for size && product.

avis.titre: PDRN Facial Mist meeting expectations so far
avis.texte: I have only used the PDRN facial mist a few times but so far I am happy with the product. It it easy to use and doesn't leave a film on my face. There is no smell to the product. I am not having any adverse reaction to the mist.
I'm loving this product. It absorbs well and gives my skin a hydrated glow. It sprays as a fine mist.

avis.titre: I love everything from VT Cosmetics,definitely one of my favorite skincare brands,for sure!!!!!
avis.texte: Love the VT Cosmetics PDRN Glow ampoule!! A must try! Along with everything else from the PDRN line by VT COSMETICS!!!!!!
This is a really nice product. Leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated during the day after a quick spritz. I do recommend this product!!
يرطب ويعطي منظر الglow بس مؤقت بعدها لازم ارجع ابخ منه جيد بس لايعني عن الترطيب

Benutze ich fast jeden Tag morgens, abends und zwischendurch obwohl ich viele andere ähnliche Produkte habe. Dieses bleibt jetzt mein Favorit. Die Haut ist sehr „smooth“ - also glatt und geschmeidig. Es ist fast leer (viele Monate gehalten) und das Produkt wird erneut gekauft.

La confezione spray è molto pratico, eroga comodamente il prodotto senza sprechi. Lascia la pelle idratata e luminosa senza ungere. E' un altro prodotto della skincare koreana ben fatto. L'unico problema è che non è possibile farlo recapitare ad un punto di raccolta ma bisogna aspettare che il pacchetto arrivi a casa.

I love a lot about this spray and have not experienced the same absorption or stickiness issues others have. PDRN is an interesting ingredient that is all the rage these days. It has become the source of endless jokes with my girlfriend once I learned that it is derived using Salmon sperm stem cells. While it makes for a great joke, PDRN is no joke in reality. Numerous studies have shown that it can significantly boost collagen production in the skin. Further, my skins feels more elastic after use. It is noticeable. VT is a high end Korean skincare company. They are currently one of a handful of companies (mostly Korean) that is really diving into PDRN. There are many more coming I am sure. For me, this is a reasonably priced great way to get into this new ingredient. It is also a nice way to refresh your moisturizer during the day as long as you aren’t wearing makeup. Recommend.

avis.titre: Nice on my bare skin - Very hydrating. Not as good over makeup.
avis.texte: At first I was not really sure how to use this within my skin routine, but I think it's more of a supplementary product for the skin and not necessarily something to use strictly as part of the overall routine. It appears that it's something you spray when your face is feeling dry, and it mentions "AM and PM" in the ads. It says you can put it over makeup, so I did spray it over my full coverage CC cream. It did not dislodge anything but it did take a while for it to dry/absorb. It seemed to help keep my skin from feeling dry later in the day (typical for me) however it did make my makeup feel...heavier for lack of a better description. So I am not a big fan of that. But in my opinion, where it shines is using it on clean, dry skin. I did a couple of sprays on my makeup-free face the last few days and I love the feeling it provides. It feels light, gives my skin a hydrated feel. When the skin is clean, it still takes a while to absorb, but did not feel greasy. I really like how refreshed it made my skin feel overall. Visually, I have not detected obvious skin differences as yet, but it's only been under a week. So, I'll update should I see a remarkable luminous glow!

Pros: - An effortless way to achieve a radiant, dewy complexion without a heavy, sticky residue, the VT Cosmetics PDRN Glow Ampoule Mist is a must-have product. - No Makeup Disruption: it is ideal for layering over full-coverage makeup to revive a cakey or dry finish. - True Deep Hydration - Exceptional Value for an effective Korean mist. Cons: - None so far. I update the review if something changed.

Came well packed and in time. This Glow Ampoule is a lightweight and refreshing facial mist that deeply hydrates the skin. This vegan, fragrance-free serum helps to plump the skin, giving it a healthy, glowing look. Its gentle formula is perfect for all skin types and absorbs quickly without feeling heavy or sticky. With regular use, it improves skin moisture and leaves the face feeling smooth and refreshed. A great choice for anyone looking to add extra hydration and a radiant glow to their skincare routine.

avis.titre: I love this product. But disappointed about delivery package:(
avis.texte: The box seal was not applied to one side, and there is no seal inside the product either. It appears that someone may have already opened it.

I was not impressed with this face moisturizer. It doesn’t moisturize very well in my opinion but instead leaves kind of a weird feeling (tacky, filmy) on the face unless you rub it in which negates the “glow” effect it advertises. It says fragrance free but it has a light neutral oil scent to me. Also, it makes your skin more sensitive to the sun, says so right on the packaging. Overall a miss for me.

avis.titre: Can feel quite refreshing putting it on.
avis.texte: I wasn't sure why it's in a mist form, until I sprayed it on my face, it was a little bit of a shock, and it was refreshing to be honest. I did use my hands to rub it in, they recommend letting it absorb naturally, I just was not able to do that. It doesn't get tacky or sticky as it dries, seems to absorb well into the skin, and seems the moisturized decently. I don't have really dry skin, but I do need lotion after washing my face, this hydrates my skin, and doesn't leave me looking greasy. I can't say I've noticed any improvements with fine lines or anything like that, but it's pleasant to apply, it has a slight smell that disappears quite quickly, and seems to work all right. Takes about three sprays for me.

avis.titre: Very fine hydrating mist and quickly absorbable
avis.texte: Well I haven't seen a big different is softer skin, but it does gove my skin a healthier glow and feels hydrating. The mist is very fine and absorbs quite well.
